events.title: Employee is killed when crushed by tipping JCB Loadall teleh…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Rhode Island Disposal, Inc. Burrillville, RI. At 8:40 a.m. on November 9, 2024, Employee #1 was operating a JCB Loadall telehandler to assist with the removal of a tree. Employee #1 was using the forks of the machine to guide the tree down while a coworker cut the tree with achainsaw. As the tree was cut, the weight of the tree against the forks caused the telehandler to tip over. Employee #1 was thrown from the machine and was subsequently crushed by it, sustaining fatal crushing injuries.

events.title: Employee collapses holding chest, dies from hyperthermia
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Dhc Services Corp. Providence, RI. At 2:00 p.m. on June 18, 2024, an employee working as a construction laborer for a commercial building contractor was removing caulk from windows with a reciprocating power tool. The employee collapsed while holding his chest. The employee had died from a heat-related illness.

events.title: Employee dies of heart attack
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Care New England Health System. Providence, RI. At 11:03 a.m. on January 19, 2024, an employee was performing her normal job duties as a secretary. Before the incident, she was working at her desk and making rounds around the office area. The employee was found unresponsive in therestroom. The employee died due to acute myocardial infarction with ASCVD.

events.title: Employee is killed in fall from roof
events.description: 1 worker death. Woonsocket, RI. At 3:30 p.m. on October 25, 2023, Employee #1 was on a roof, cutting out old wood boards, so they could install new metal roofing in its place. Employee #1 fell from the roof to the concrete ground below and suffered multiple head and face injuries. Employee #1 was killed.

events.title: Employee is killed in fall from ladder
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: M & D Home Service Inc. New Shoreham, RI. At 2:49 p.m. on February 14, 2023, Employee #1 was holding the ladder in place while the employer was utilizing the ladder to set up roof staging. Employee #1 ascended the ladder to tie the ladder off to the deck railing. Employee #1 fell approximately 15 feet to the ground floor, landing on a metal fence post. The fence post impaled the employee through the left lateral chest wall and out of the right lateral neck. The employee was killed.

events.title: Employee dies from suspected hyperthermia
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Durand Septic Designs And Services. Cumberland, RI. At 1:45 p.m. on June 8, 2022, an employee was performing site grading at a residential construction jobsite. The employee was spreading loam at the site during dry weather conditions with approximately 80 degrees F ambient temperature. The employee became ill at the jobsite and died from suspected hyperthermia.

events.title: Employee dies of coronary incident
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Conrad-Jarvis Corporation. Pawtucket, RI. At 12:00 p.m. on February 7, 2022, an employee was working in the storage area, when he had a medical coronary incident and died.

events.title: Employee dies due to diabetes
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Mermaids Newport, Llc. Newport, RI. At 12:45 a.m. on February 5, 2022, an employee was waiting for his coworker to finish, so he could lock up. The employee fell twice and was helped up by the coworker. He went downstairs to the first floor of the establishment, where he was later found to be unresponsive. The employee had diabetes and was believed to be suffering from low blood sugar levels at the time the incident occurred.

events.title: Employee is killed when struck in head by cement truck fins…

At 10:00 a.m. on October 21, 2021, an employee was installing a fabricated plate in a cement truck hopper. The employee placed his head in the spinning truck drum and was struck by the spinning fins inside the drum, killing him.

events.title: Employee is killed when caught in polishing machine
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Chemart Company. Lincoln, RI. At 7:15 a.m on October 2, 2021, an employee was applying buffing compound to thebuffing wheels of a polishing machine. The employee became caught in the buffingwheels, pulling him into the polishing machine, striking his head and upper torso against the front of the machine, causing fatal injuries.

events.title: Employee is killed after hitting head on rock in fall from t…

events.title: Employee is killed when crushed between truck and container…
events.description: 1 worker death. East Providence, RI. At 9:40 a.m. on August 31, 2020, Employee # 1 had just completed the hoist, tipping, and dumping of a metal trash container, and had set the container back on the ground behind the truck, where he was standing. The truck moved backward while Employee # 1 was standing between the truck and the metal trash container.He sustained serious crushing type injuries, resulting in his death.

events.title: Employee with COVID-19 infection dies
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Rhode Island Hospital. Providence, RI. An employee worked her scheduled shifts treating patients as a nurse on the COVID-19 response team. The employee contracted the disease and died due to complications from COVID-19 on June 20, 2020.

events.title: Employees with COVID-19 infection die

Both employees died due to complications from the COVID-19 virus.

events.title: Employee is killed when struck by log
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Warwick Tree Acquisition Corporation. Richmond, RI. The employee was struck by a log as it came into the front of the cab. The log struck the employee in the torso, causing blunt force trauma injuries, killing the employee.

events.title: Employee is killed in fall from pump jack scaffold
events.description: 1 worker death. Providence, RI. On May 2, 2019, Employee #1, employed by a construction company, was engaged in renovation work at an existing three-story multifamily residence. He was working from a pump jack scaffold and replacing boards on the building's soffits. Employee #1 stumbled and fell from the scaffold. He was killed in thefall.

events.title: Employee is overcome by heat stress and is killed

events.title: Employee contacts power line, later dies

The employee was shocked and caught on fire, dying later in the hospital. hospital.

events.title: Employee is stung by bees and is killed

events.title: Employee suffers a heart attack and dies

events.title: Employee has a heart attack at work and dies
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Electric Boat Corporation. North Kingstown, RI. At approximately 3:30 p.m. on December 13, 2016, an employee had just arrived at his work station and was talking to a coworker while they were waiting to receive their work assignments for the day. While talking to a coworker before starting work, the employee suffered a heart attack and died. The employee suffered from hypertensive atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease with remote myocardial infarction and coronary artery stenting.
